headline: India: stocks close flat
summary: Indian stocks were stable on Friday, with the BSE Sensex steady at 74,294.96 points. The benchmark index showed no significant move in the session.
why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of the Bombay Stock Exchange, tracking 30 large Indian companies. It is a key gauge of Indian equity market sentiment.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index closed essentially flat, showing no directional move in the session.
